1	import type { AgentTeamProjectRef, AgentTeamThreadReadFact, AgentTeamThreadRef } from './types/entities.ts'
2	import type { AgentTeamInboxItem, AgentTeamInboxReminder, AgentTeamMainTimelineEntry } from './types/requests-results.ts'
3	
4	/**
5	 * Every unread fact interrupts: there is one delivery class. An ordinary Thread
6	 * update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, a mention or a
7	 * reply carries a direct marker, and a responsibility Activity or live Task
8	 * reminder arrives through its own marker — so what decides whether ordinary
9	 * work exists at all is Attention, never how fast it travels. No identity
10	 * chooses a slower class here. `covered` is what keeps an unchanged
11	 * rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts.
12	 */
13	export type InboxDelivery = 'immediate'
14	
15	/** The reader's role in one notice scope, as the notice states it. */
16	export type InboxScopeRole = 'follower' | 'member'
17	
18	export interface InboxThreadUnread {
19	  readonly item: AgentTeamInboxItem
20	  readonly facts: readonly AgentTeamThreadReadFact[]
21	  readonly reminders?: readonly AgentTeamInboxReminder[]
22	}
23	
24	export interface InboxMainUnread {
25	  readonly projectRef: AgentTeamProjectRef
26	  readonly entries: readonly AgentTeamMainTimelineEntry[]
27	}
28	
29	export interface InboxDeliveryInput {
30	  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadUnread[]
31	  readonly main: readonly InboxMainUnread[]
32	  /** Signature of the immediate facts the last delivery attempt answered. */
33	  readonly covered: string | undefined
34	  /**
35	   * Threads the last notice could not render, so its facts were never delivered.
36	   * Their facts still enter this signature — otherwise an unchanged
37	   * rederivation would look identical to the delivered one — but the facts the
38	   * last attempt actually answered are the ones `covered` may match.
39	   */
40	  readonly undelivered?: readonly AgentTeamThreadRef[] | undefined
41	}
42	
43	export interface InboxThreadPlan {
44	  readonly threadRef: AgentTeamThreadRef
45	  readonly role: InboxScopeRole
46	  readonly delivery: InboxDelivery
47	}
48	
49	export interface InboxDeliveryPlan {
50	  /** Why a notice goes out now, or `undefined` when nothing may interrupt the reader. */
51	  readonly trigger: InboxDelivery | undefined
52	  readonly signature: string
53	  /** The signature the next rederivation compares `covered` against: everything the notice can actually render. */
54	  readonly delivered: string
55	  readonly threads: readonly InboxThreadPlan[]
56	}
57	
58	export function planInboxDelivery(input: InboxDeliveryInput): InboxDeliveryPlan {
59	  const immediate: (string | number)[][] = []
60	  const delivered: (string | number)[][] = []
61	  const threads: InboxThreadPlan[] = []
62	  const undelivered = new Set(input.undelivered ?? [])
63	  for (const { item, facts, reminders = [] } of input.threads) {
64	    const threadRef = item.thread.threadRef
65	    // A reminder is always delivered: it is the whole reason the notice exists
66	    // when the Thread holds no ordinary unread.
67	    if (reminders.length > 0) {
68	      const reminderFacts = [threadRef, 'reminder', ...reminders.map(reminder => `${reminder.kind}:${reminder.baselineSequence}`)]
69	      immediate.push(reminderFacts)
70	      delivered.push(reminderFacts)
71	    }
72	    const now = facts.map(entry => entry.fact.sequence)
73	    if (now.length > 0) immediate.push([threadRef, ...now])
74	    // A Thread the notice cannot render is not delivered by this attempt, so its
75	    // facts are not what `covered` records: an unchanged rederivation still sees
76	    // them as owed and re-attempts instead of standing down.
77	    if (now.length > 0 && !undelivered.has(threadRef)) delivered.push([threadRef, ...now])
78	    threads.push(Object.freeze({ threadRef, role: item.attention === undefined ? 'member' : 'follower', delivery: 'immediate' as const }))
79	  }
80	  for (const { projectRef, entries } of input.main) {
81	    if (entries.length > 0) { immediate.push([projectRef, ...entries.map(entry => entry.sequence)]); delivered.push([projectRef, ...entries.map(entry => entry.sequence)]) }
82	  }
83	  const signature = immediate.length === 0 ? '' : JSON.stringify(immediate)
84	  const covered = delivered.length === 0 ? '' : JSON.stringify(delivered)
85	  const trigger = signature !== '' && covered !== input.covered ? 'immediate' : undefined
86	  return Object.freeze({ trigger, signature, delivered: covered, threads: Object.freeze(threads) })
87	}

docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:6:Attention is durable private state for one Member and Thread: current period start, contiguous read watermark, and what established the period. Creating a Thread (its author follows), creating a Task Claim, being named accountable — by a transfer, a promotion, or a reopen — or explicitly following starts it; a rules-version-1 mention started it too, which is the only source version 2 no longer produces. Taskless Threads can be unfollowed directly; taskful Threads require no active Claim. Unfollow ends the period and discards its unread work; a later follow starts at the current tail.
docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:10:While active, other Members' Messages—and taskful Claim and Task resolution Activities—become ordinary unread. Mentions create durable direct markers. The sender's own mutation is not unread. Promotion creates a `promote` Activity for current followers. Follow/unfollow/read are private and do not advance Thread revision. Close ends Attention; reopen does not restore old periods, but a new reopen restores the accountable's current follow unless the accountable is the actor or already follows.
docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:20:Both Thread faces render one follow control: its pressed state is read from the Host's current follower set asked about the Human's own Member id, the write goes through the Human `changeAttention` Remote, and the control never optimistically flips, so a refused write leaves the previous standing on screen with its failure beside the control. The Human-only follow/unfollow observations themselves are not rendered as history.
docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:55:Withdrawing Project ownership is not an unfollow: the Member keeps the Main stream Attention it was granted and keeps receiving ordinary updates until it reads or unfollows. Only the owner privilege is gone. Member removal and archival end the row, the same as Thread Attention; leaving a Workspace and archiving the Project do not, so a Member that returns finds its Attention where it left it.
docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:42:4. active Claims only — the current collision surface, one line per Claim (claim ref, owner, direction);
docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:55:`team_attention` answers one question — am I following this Thread or this Project's Main stream, and should I be? `status` reports the current state and changes nothing; `follow` starts receiving ordinary updates from there; `unfollow` stops them. All three take the address and the routing Workspace. `threadRef` is primary for a Thread, with `taskRef` as the compatibility alias, and `projectRef` addresses the Main stream instead — exactly one of the three, and a call carrying both a Thread and a `projectRef` is refused rather than silently preferring one.
docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:61:Every result states the consequence its verb alone does not carry. Following means ordinary updates from there interrupt you. Unfollowing means they stop, while a mention, a reply to you, and a responsibility event still reach you — and unfollowing releases no Claim and drops no Task you are accountable for, so it is a subscription change rather than a withdrawal from the work. An active Claim on the Task refuses the Thread unfollow until it is done or released. [Attention and messaging](attention-and-messaging.md) owns the rows themselves.
docs/team-collaboration/tools.md:111:`list`, `claim`, `done`, and `release` manage only the Agent's own Direction Claims on real Tasks. Taskless Threads have no Claim mutation. A Direction is one sentence describing the Agent's angle; plans and acceptance checklists belong in Thread messages. A successful Claim starts Attention. `list` renders the Task/Thread identity with the active collision surface — active Claims only, or an explicit none — and no write token, because a current `team_thread read` remains the required mutation basis.

result.output:
---
name: team-domain-model
description: Reference for how a Project, its owners and members, the Main stream, Threads, Tasks, and notifications work in this Team. Read this skill when you are unsure who may start a discussion or Task, claim, accept, close, reopen, or transfer one; whether a mention, a reply, or an ordinary message will interrupt someone; whether something belongs in the Main stream, a Thread, or a DM; when to look at the board or Inbox; or after a rejection such as project_owner_required, not_project_member, main_unread_required, unread_required, stale_revision, self_acceptance_forbidden, or accountable_owner_required. Stable rules only, never current state.
---

# Team Domain Model

Stable rules for acting in a Project. Current state comes from your context and the Team tools, never from this skill; the Host enforces every rule below, and this text only helps you avoid rejections.

## Roles and permissions

- **Human**: always an owner of every Project. May accept, close, reopen, or take back any Task at any time, including accepting early. Cannot be DMed and does not Claim.
- **Project owner**: the Human, plus any Agents the Human names. Your context lists the Projects you own.
- **Project member**: owners, anyone mentioned in the Project, anyone who has spoken, claimed, or followed there, and legacy explicit members — limited to Members still in the Workspace and not archived or inactive.
- **Accountable**: the one owner who drives a Task to acceptance — an Agent Project owner or the Human. An Agent owner creating a Task is accountable by default; a Human names one or leaves it to the Human. It either verifies the work or transfers it.

| Action | Who | Otherwise |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read a Project, post, reply | Project member | `not_project_member` |
| `team_message` start (discussion or Task) | Project owner | `project_owner_required` |
| Promote a discussion to a Task (`team_task` promote) | Human, Project owner | `project_owner_required` |
| `team_task` claim | Agent Project member, open Task | rejected |
| `team_task` done / release | Only the Claim's owner | `claim_owned_by_another` |
| `team_task` accept | Human; a Project owner who never claimed it, only at in_review | `self_acceptance_forbidden` |
| `team_task` close / reopen / transfer | Human, current accountable | `accountable_owner_required` |

If you are not an owner and something needs a discussion or Task, post in the Main stream and mention an owner. Once a Task is accepted or closed, Claim changes are refused; a closed Task also refuses replies until reopened.

## Main stream and Threads

- The **Main stream** is the Project's open conversation: questions, heads-up, requests. It has no Task, Claim, or write token, and ordinary posts never create a Thread. Discussions and Tasks appear in it as cards. It has its own Attention: `team_attention` with `projectRef` follows or unfollows it.
- A **Thread** is one standing question (discussion) or one piece of work (Task), opened by an owner with its first message. Work, decisions, and evidence go there.
- A **Task** is a Thread with a work status derived from its Claims: todo (none), in_progress (a Claim is active), in_review (none active, one done). An accept (done) or close overrides it.
- **DM** (`team_dm`): a brief private question to one enabled Agent in your Workspace, or detailed evidence for one peer. Never task work or decisions; past about 3 exchanges, move to a Thread. Recorded even if the recipient cannot be woken; never resend blindly.
- `@all` has no special meaning; it is plain text. Mention each Member as `@Handle`.

## Mention, reply, ordinary message

| You write | Who is notified | Immediate? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@Handle` in the body | that Member, once, for that Message only | yes |
| Reply with `replyToMessageRef` | the author of that Message, like a mention | yes |
| Ordinary Thread message | Thread followers | immediately |
| Main stream message | the Project's other owners | yes |
| New discussion | other owners, like a Main stream post | yes |
| New Task | not other owners; they find it on the board | no |

- A mention or reply never makes someone follow and never delivers earlier messages; whoever enters cold reads `team_thread` history first.
- Following controls ordinary updates only: starting a Thread or a successful Claim follows it, replying does not. Owning a Project follows its Main stream from the grant, not its Threads. `team_attention` follows or unfollows either face and reads nothing; unfollowing stops ordinary updates only.
- An ordinary message does not notify the author you answer: when you answer an owner or report a result, mention them or link the reply.

## Where to look

- **Inbox** (`team_inbox`): your own unread, split into ordinary unread and direct notices (mentions, linked replies, responsibility events). Read items with `team_thread`; the Main stream is read with `projectRef`.
- **Board** (`team_task board`): every open Task with its status, accountable owner, and who is on it, plus recently finished work, whether or not you have unread; `mine` narrows to what you are accountable for or execute. Look before claiming, and when a new Task matters.
- `team_view` is also the address book for Projects, Members, and recent Threads.

## Task lifecycle

1. An owner starts a Task (`kind: task`, optionally naming `accountable` and `sourceThreadRefs`) or promotes a discussion in place; a derived Task shows its card in those Threads, an in-place promotion records no source.
2. An Agent member announces in the Thread and claims one Direction (`team_task claim`), making it in_progress.
3. The Claim holder reports verification in the Thread, then marks its own Claim `done`. With no active Claim and one done, the Task is in_review.
4. `accept` verifies finished work: the Human any time, an Agent Project owner only at in_review and only if it never claimed the Task — released Claims count, and reopening does not clear that. `close` ends it unaccepted, `reopen` returns it to open work, and `transfer` hands responsibility on without moving Claims. Report, mention whoever waits, close out.
5. `release` abandons your Claim; an unclaimed Task stays open.

## Rejections and recovery

| Code | Meaning | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project_owner_required` | Only an owner starts or promotes a Thread | `post` in the Main stream and mention an owner |
| `not_project_member` | You are not a member of that Project | Choose a Project from `team_view`, or ask the Human or an owner to mention you |
| `main_unread_required` | Unread Main stream entries (ordinary unread your Attention covers, or any mention) | `team_thread read` with `projectRef`, then post |
| `unread_required` | Unread facts in the Thread | `team_thread read` until drained, reconsider, then write |
| `stale_revision` | The Thread moved since your token | Read again; use the new token |
| `missing_write_token` | No token supplied | Drain with a read, or reuse your last committed mutation's token |
| `claim_owned_by_another` | Not your Claim | `team_task list`, change only your own |
| `self_acceptance_forbidden` | You claimed this Task, so you cannot verify it | Ask the Human, or `transfer` it to an owner who never claimed it |
| `accountable_owner_required` | Only the accountable or the Human | Ask them to act, or to transfer it to you |
| `reply_target_unknown` | `replyToMessageRef` is not in this Thread or Main stream | Copy a messageRef from a read or notice |
| `unknown_ref`, `ambiguous_ref` | Bad or short ref | Reuse the full ref |
| `workspace_required`, `workspace_not_participating` | Workspace unclear | Pass `workspace` from `team_view` |

A rejection supplies no write basis: read the named Thread or Main stream, reconsider, then write again.

Once the ledger has Project owners (rules version 2), each Project row also names its owners, `@human` first, and the reader's role (`owner` or `member`).

Work in flight is not part of the address book: the first page ends by pointing to `team_task board`.

The cursor pages Thread rows only; continuation pages render Threads alone, and paging reaches every authorized top-level Thread, including taskless and off-page taskful ones. The footer calls the value a Thread cursor and says whether older Thread anchors remain.

## `team_inbox`

`team_inbox` lists bounded body-free unread Thread summaries, plus one row per Project whose Main stream holds unread for the reader (the ordinary unread its Main stream Attention covers, plus every reader's markers). Direct requests sort before ordinary unread, then by newest relevant sequence; listing does not mark read.

The header states the total unread and direct counts and the number of Threads shown, with a truncation conclusion when unread work lies beyond the bounded list; each row shows its exact unread and direct counts, Project ref, and Task standing when taskful. This is the reader's own unread queue; to see work in flight regardless of unread, use `team_task board`.

The footer routes body reading and acknowledgement to `team_thread read`; the render carries no revision and no write token — a current read is the required mutation basis, and it supplies the token.

## `team_thread`

`team_thread` reads one Thread. `threadRef` is primary; `taskRef` is a compatibility alias for released task-only Clients on taskful Threads.

`read` returns one chronological unread batch and advances the watermark. A read with nothing unread for its reader advances nothing and writes no operation, and an identical retry of a committed read returns that read's original receipt with a picture derived from the current projection, because a read has never promised a frozen answer. `history` pages older facts. `message` reads one Message back verbatim by its ref, which is the way to answer a quote whose original sits outside the page you hold.

result.output:
The control says its standing before it says its action. A followed Thread shows the pressed fill (the shipped selected vocabulary, so the two standings differ by more than a stroke) and a failure never flips it, so the button a reader pressed still shows what the Host last answered. Its visible verb is short while the accessible name keeps the full phrase, which is what lets it share one band with the Task's own actions.

While that write runs, the accessible name takes the long pending phrase rather than the idle one: the shortened visible word is not what a screen reader reads, so an unchanged name would leave the write's progress unannounced.

## Agent delivery
The Host computes delivery from the current Inbox; delivery class is runtime state, not a durable fact on the Message or Activity. There is one delivery class: every unread fact interrupts.

| Unread fact | Agent recipient | Delivery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Thread mention or reply, responsibility Activity, Main stream marker, or live Task reminder | Any | Immediate |
| Thread ordinary fact | A follower of that Thread | Immediate |
| Main stream ordinary fact, including a new discussion | A reader whose Attention covers it | Immediate |

Attention decides whether ordinary work exists at all, never how fast it travels: an ordinary Thread update reaches a reader only because it follows that Thread, and an ordinary Main stream update only because its Attention covers that Main stream. Owning a Project does not choose a slower class, so a reader that follows a Thread is interrupted by its first ordinary update, and a reader that stops following it stops accumulating ordinary unread there.

A `covered` signature keeps an unchanged rederivation from spending a second attempt on the same durable facts. It lives in process memory, so a restart may deliver the same facts again — at-least-once delivery, not durable delivery bookkeeping. A notice already queued but not yet read is replaced rather than stacked, so a burst of commits on one Thread leaves one notice carrying the newest unread set.

## Main stream Attention

The Main stream carries its own Attention, keyed by Member × Project rather than by a Thread ref: it is a conversation outside every Thread, so giving it a synthetic Thread ref would put it in the Thread indexes. Thread Attention and Main stream Attention are two independent rows for the same Member, each with its own read watermark.

| Who | Main stream Attention |
| --- | --- |
| The Human | Derived, never stored: it starts at the Project's creation, and only the read watermark is stored |
| A Member granted Project ownership | Written by the grant itself, starting at the grant sequence — no historical backlog is inherited |
| Any other Member | Absent until it follows; then it starts at the current tail |

A Member that does not follow the Main stream holds markers alone, exactly as a Thread reader who does not follow that Thread: a mention or a reply still reaches it, and so does every Activity that names it. Following does not double-count a marker it already holds. Unfollowing stops the ordinary updates and leaves the markers standing.

Withdrawing Project ownership is not an unfollow: the Member keeps the Main stream Attention it was granted and keeps receiving ordinary updates until it reads or unfollows. Only the owner privilege is gone. Member removal and archival end the row, the same as Thread Attention; leaving a Workspace and archiving the Project do not, so a Member that returns finds its Attention where it left it.

A Task reminder participates only while its current durable conditions still hold. Reading filters stale reminders from Inbox and wake planning without rewriting the ledger; [model-and-time.md](model-and-time.md) owns the conditions and read-time rules.

## Mentions
A Message names its recipients in its own body: writing `@Handle` is what makes a mention, matched against the Project's addressable names case-insensitively, on Unicode word boundaries, and longest handle first, so a name the Client renders as a chip is the same name that delivers. A bare handle stays ordinary prose, and a handle inside a code block or code span is quoted rather than called. `@all` is plain text under rules version 2: it notifies no one, so every Member that must be reached is named.

3:All notable changes to this project are documented in this file. The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/) and Semantic Versioning. Team bundle versions evolve independently of DeepSeek Harness versions; DeepSeek Harness compatibility is expressed through `peerDependencies` and [`docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md`](docs/dsh-release-compatibility.md).
15:- Responsibility events reach the Inbox as direct facts regardless of Attention: being made accountable, entering review, a Task left unowned, reopen, and needs-your-acceptance when the accountable owner executed the work.
16:- A Task may record its originating discussion (`sourceThreadRefs`, immutable, same Project); sourced Tasks leave the Main stream and appear as read-only cards inside the discussions they came from. The board adds the `accountable` relation and flags Tasks awaiting an owner's acceptance.
18:- Notices are delivered by Attention. Every unread fact interrupts: a Main stream post, a new discussion, mentions, replies, ownership events, responsibility events and Task reminders wake immediately, and so does an ordinary Thread update for any Member following that Thread. The former owner and accountable threshold — five ordinary Thread updates per Member per Thread before a summary — is gone, so following a Thread now means being interrupted by its first ordinary update, and no identity places a reader in a slower class. The sender's own messages never enter the sender's Inbox.
19:- A Main stream commit wakes every Member whose Main stream Attention covers that stream, not only the Project's owners, so a non-owner follower is interrupted by the first ordinary update like anyone else. Following a Main stream requires Project membership, exactly as reading and writing it do, so an Attention row left behind by a departed Member delivers nothing and the follow cannot be the door that gets a Member in.
20:- An ownership grant no longer overwrites the Main stream Attention a Member already holds: a Member that followed and read before being granted ownership keeps its own read watermark, so granting ownership no longer silently clears its unread. The Human's own row is derived from owning the Project, so a Main stream unfollow from the Human is refused instead of committing an operation that changes nothing; `team_attention` takes `projectRef` or a Thread ref, never both, at the Host as well as the tool.
22:- An Attention row records what established it — starting the Thread, claiming its Task, being its accountable, owning the Project, being named in it, or choosing to follow — so a result can state why the reader follows instead of guessing. `team_attention` renders the cause once the reader follows, and a Claim result or a Thread start names the Attention it just established. content.text:
## 结论

**领域模型落地得不错，但按“可交付”标准还不能算完成：当前 HEAD 打不开你 dev profile 的真实账本，Host 会启动失败。** 归档 README 里“只剩人工试用”这句话不成立。

我实际跑过，不是只读归档自述：

| 检查 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 全量 `vitest` | 122 files / **1418 passed**, 1 skipped |
| `typecheck`（单独跑） | 通过，0 error |
| `check:docs` / `check:core-skills` | 通过 |
| 复制 `~/.dsh/storages/agent_team.sqlite`（25,525 条操作）用当前 HEAD 重放 | **失败**：`invalid Thread read projection` |
| 同一账本用 `7558dfd`（source 字段之前）重放 | **通过** |

## 阻断项：真实账本无法重放

失败点是 sequence 5，一条 2026-08-21 的 legacy Thread read 快照。它和当前推导只差一个字段：

```text
.attention.source   文件里 = undefined    当前推导 = "mention"
```

两个原因叠加：

1. `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 只修补 `inbox` 里的 Attention 行，**不修补快照自带的 `attention` 字段**；而 `validateLegacyThreadReadSnapshot` 会把它一起比较。
2. `legacyAttentionSourceOf` 对 `team/thread-read` 这类“只推进水位、不建立关注”的操作没有分支，落到默认值 `self`，把本该继承的 `mention` 补错了。

我在只读探针里补上这两处后，账本完整重放通过：

- read 类操作继承已有 Attention 行的 `source`；
- legacy 快照比较忽略 `attention.source`（该形状冻结于 source 之前）。

这说明它是 `23ed8ee` / `3fb6bed` 引入的回归，不是账号数据坏了。全量测试仍全绿，因为测试里没有一条“v1 mention → legacy 快照读取 → 带 source 修复”的真实形状。

## 对照预期，还差这些

| 预期 | 实际 |
|---|---|
| Thread 普通消息由 Attention 决定 | **达成**，threshold 已彻底移除 |
| Main stream 并入 Attention、owner 与非 owner 对称 | **基本达成**；Human 的 Main Attention 是派生的、不能 unfollow，这是对原设计的偏离，已写进文档 |
| 默认 Attention 与身份变化 | **达成**；授权不覆盖已有 follow，撤销不收回 |
| Agent 指导 | **部分**：source 已记录并渲染；显式 follow 仍没说“更早内容可读”；status 仍用“不再打扰”这种变更措辞 |
| 迁移与重放 | **未达成**：合成用例过，真实账本失败 |
| 文档 / CHANGELOG | **部分**：主文档对齐，但模型可见文案仍有旧模型 |
| 人工试用 | 未做，且被上述阻断项卡住 |

## 模型可见的旧表述仍在

这些直接影响 Agent 行为，不是普通文档瑕疵：

- [`tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:475`](packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:475)：`team_thread` 描述仍说 Main stream 读的是 “an owner's unread”。
- [`tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:817`](packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:817)：`team_message` 仍说 “An owner holding unread Main stream … reads it first”。
- [`team-domain-model/SKILL.md:44-45`](packages/agent-team/core-skills/team-domain-model/SKILL.md:44)：Main stream 消息和 new discussion 仍写成“其他 owners 收到”。
- [`scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts:105`](scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts:105)、`:108-110`：试用指标仍按“Main 只通知 owner、Thread 回复跳过 owner”统计；`:176` 还写着 threshold。你的最后一项验收是 dev profile 试用，而这个脚本正是试用指标工具，数字会失真。
- `CHANGELOG.md:22` 说 source “excluded from replay validation”，实际实现是修复后参与严格比较。

## 票据里两个未真正闭合的条件

- `02.6` 的失败重试测试：用例名叫 “retries a failed wake…”，但 [`post-commit-delivery.spec.ts:162`](packages/agent-team/tests/post-commit-delivery.spec.ts:162) 在操作前就设了 `state.fail = false`，从未注入失败。归档评审自己标了“未做”，README 仍写全部完成。
- `05.3` 的“显式 follow 说明更早内容可读”：[`index.ts:393`](packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:393) 只说了后续更新会到达，没有这一句。

## 我的判断

- **行为层**：5 张票据的核心领域行为基本达到预期，主模型是对的。
- **交付层**：差一个 blocker + 三类收尾（模型可见文案、试用指标、两个测试缺口）。
- **归档记录**：高估了完成度。它不是故意虚报，而是评审后又追加了 source 字段，最后一轮没有拿真实账本重放。

建议顺序：先修重放 blocker 并加一条真实形状的回归用例 → 修模型可见文案和试用指标 → 补两个测试缺口 → 跑 `test:browser`（Client 的 `standing.owner` 改成了 `following`）→ 再做 dev profile 人工试用。

要我现在直接修这个 blocker 吗？这会新增一个提交，但不改变已归档的领域设计。
看起来不少问题啊。因为这个scratch还是挺重要的，你把其从archive拉出来吧。把你的review在开个报告，我们回来让team专门处理这个问题
我会把整个工作项从归档移回 `active/`，保留原设计与票据，新增一份最终完成度复核报告，并在 README 里写清重新打开的原因和当前前沿。归档目录会从版本库中移出（`active/` 本就是 gitignored）。

Member removal and archival end the row, the same as Thread Attention; leaving a Workspace and archiving the Project do not, so a Member that returns finds its Attention where it left it.
CHANGELOG.md:22:- An Attention row records what established it — starting the Thread, claiming its Task, being its accountable, owning the Project, being named in it, or choosing to follow — so a result can state why the reader follows instead of guessing. `team_attention` renders the cause once the reader follows, and a Claim result or a Thread start names the Attention it just established. # Review 02 — 最终完成度复核

**结论：阻塞，工作项重新打开。**

| 项目 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 复核对象 | `attention-delivery-model` 的归档状态与当前 `HEAD`（`575747c`） |
| 复核日期 | 2026-10-28 |
| 复核范围 | 5 张票据的验收条件、`DESIGN.md` 的 9 条验收测试缝、真实 dev-profile 账本重放、模型可见文案、试用指标脚本 |
| 方法 | 只读检查；运行全量测试与门禁；复制真实账本到 `/tmp` 重放；用内存探针定位差异。未修改仓库代码 |
| 归档结论 | 归档 README 称「5 张 tickets 全部完成，仅剩人工试用」。本次复核认为该结论高估完成度 |

## 一、结论摘要

1. **领域模型主体已落地。** Thread 与 Main stream 的普通更新均由 Attention 决定；owner threshold 已删除；Main stream Attention、默认关注、来源字段和多数 Agent 指导均已实现。
2. **当前构建无法重放真实 dev-profile 账本。** `new AgentTeamLedger(...)` 在 sequence 5 抛 `invalid Thread read projection`，Host 会因此启动失败。该问题由 Attention `source` 字段的追加修复引入；在 `7558dfd`（source 字段之前）上同一账本可以完整重放。
3. **模型可见文案与试用指标仍按旧模型。** `team_thread`、`team_message` 的 tool description 和 `team-domain-model` core skill 仍称 Main stream 只有 owner 收到普通未读；`scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts` 仍按「Main 只通知 owner、Thread 回复跳过 owner」统计。
4. **两张票据仍有未闭合的验收条件。** 02.6 的失败重试测试从未注入失败；05.3 的显式 follow 结果未说明历史内容仍可读取。归档票据均勾选为完成，与事实不符。

## 二、blocker — 真实账本无法重放

### 现象

对 `/home/yu/.dsh/storages/agent_team.sqlite` 的只读副本执行当前构建的构造重放：

```text
Error: invalid Thread read projection
    at AgentTeamLedger.validateLegacyThreadReadSnapshot
    at AgentTeamLedger.validateOperation
    at AgentTeamLedger.validateRecords
    at AgentTeamLedger.replay
    at new AgentTeamLedger
```

账本共 25,525 条操作，首条 `2026-08-21T03:52:33Z`，末条 `2026-10-28T08:27:43Z`。失败点是 sequence 5 的 `team/thread-read`（2026-08-21），属于 source 字段出现之前的 legacy 快照形状。

### 证据

- 同一账本在 `7558dfd` 的 `ledger.ts` 上重放通过。
- 当前 `HEAD` 上，快照与当前推导的完整字段比对只有一处差异：

```text
.attention.source    存储值 = undefined    当前推导 = "mention"
```

- 修复探针同时做两处调整后，25,525 条操作全部重放通过：
  1. legacy 快照比较忽略 `attention.source`；
  2. `team/thread-read` / `team/main-stream-read` 的 source 继承既有 Attention 行。

### 根因

`source` 是后加的字段，现有修复只覆盖了 `inbox` 中的 Attention 行：

1. `repairLegacyAttentionSource` 只修补 `operation.data.inbox.attention.set` 与 `mainAttention.set`，**不修补 legacy Thread read 快照自带的 `data.attention` 字段**；而 `validateLegacyThreadReadSnapshot` 会把该字段与当前推导一起比较。
2. `legacyAttentionSourceOf` 没有 `team/thread-read` 与 `team/main-stream-read` 分支，落到默认值 `self`。这两类操作只推进已有 Attention 行的读取水位，并不建立关注；它们应继承该行已有的 source（本账本中为 `mention`），而不是写成 `self`。

即使只修快照比较，receipt 形状的读取仍会在后续 sequence 失败，差异同样是 `self` 与 `mention`。因此两处都必须修。

### 为什么测试没有发现

`legacy-main-attention.spec.ts` 覆盖了 owner grant、Claim、reopen 和 marker-only Main read，但没有覆盖「rules version 1 的 mention 建立 Attention → legacy Thread read 快照 → 当前构建重开」这一真实形状。全量测试 1,418 条全部通过，说明现有 fixture 不足以代表真实账本。

### 影响

- Host 在启动重放阶段失败，dev-profile 人工试用无法进行；归档 README 的「仅剩人工试用」不成立。
- 这是回归，不是用户账本损坏：同一文件在 source 字段引入前可正常打开。

### 修复建议

1. `validateLegacyThreadReadSnapshot` 比较时从两侧剥离 `attention.source`。该快照形状冻结于 source 字段之前，剥离与「后加字段不参与旧形状比较」的既有原则一致。
2. `legacyAttentionSourceOf` 为 `team/thread-read` 与 `team/main-stream-read` 返回已有投影行的 source；找不到行时才回退 `self`。
3. 增加回归用例：v1 mention 建立 Attention → 写入 legacy Thread read 快照 → 用当前构建重开账本，断言重放成功且 source 为 `mention`。
4. 修复后用 `scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts` 对真实账本副本再跑一次，作为独立验收。

## 三、major — 模型可见文案仍教 owner-only 投递

| 位置 | 当前表述 | 问题 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:475` | `team_thread` 描述：Main stream read 回应 “an owner's unread and the mentions of every Member” | 非 owner follower 的普通未读被排除在描述之外 |
| `packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:817` | `team_message` 描述：“An owner holding unread Main stream, or any Member holding a mention, reads it first” | 任何 Main Attention 覆盖的未读都应先读，不只是 owner |
| `packages/agent-team/core-skills/team-domain-model/SKILL.md:44-45` | Main stream message → “the Project's other owners”；New discussion → “other owners” | 应改为 Attention 覆盖该 Main stream 的读者 |

这些文本直接进入模型上下文，是本工作项「让 Agent 理解并管理 Attention」的验收对象。当前内容会让 Agent 继续按旧模型推理，例如只 @ owner、误判 `main_unread_required` 的触发者。

修复建议：统一改为 Attention 语义，并在 render/description 测试中断言关键子句；不要只改 CHANGELOG。

## 四、major — 试用指标脚本仍按旧投递模型统计

`scripts/team-trial-metrics.ts`：

- `:105` 对 `team/main-message-posted` 和 discussion `team/thread-started` 只遍历 `owners`，漏掉非 owner 的 Main Attention follower。
- `:108-110` 对 `team/thread-replied` 跳过 `owners`，仍假设 owner 走 threshold；新模型下 owner follower 也应计入 immediate。
- `:176` 的限制说明仍写 “threshold-qualified ordinary facts are excluded”，threshold 已不存在。

影响：剩余验收正是 dev-profile 试用，而该脚本是试用指标工具；当前统计会同时少算 owner 的 Thread 普通更新和非 owner 的 Main 普通更新。

修复建议：按 Main Attention 行 + 派生 Human 行统计 Main 收件人；Thread 回复按全部 follower 统计；更新限制说明；用「非 owner Main follower」和「owner Thread follower」两个 fixture 锁定。

## 五、minor — 票据验收条件未真正闭合

### 02.6 失败重试测试没有注入失败

`packages/agent-team/tests/post-commit-delivery.spec.ts:152` 的用例名为「retries a failed wake over ordinary Thread unread alone」，但 `:162` 在操作开始前就设置了 `state.fail = false`。唯一真正注入失败的用例是更早的 mention 路径（`wakeSeam` 默认 `fail: true`）。因此「无 marker 的普通未读失败后重试」仍未被验证。

### 05.3 显式 follow 缺少「更早内容可读」

`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:393` 的 follow 结果只说明后续普通更新会打断，没有说明更早内容仍可通过读取与 history 获取。归档票据将该项勾为完成。

### 05 的 status 措辞仍未区分查询与变更

`team_attention status` 对一个从未 follow 的流仍使用 `Ordinary updates will no longer interrupt you…`，描述了一次没有发生的变化。归档 review 01 已记录该 nit，并延后到 `agent-tools-context-rendering`；本次复核确认仍在。

## 六、文档事实错误

`CHANGELOG.md:22` 称 Attention `source` “is excluded from replay validation”。实际实现会在修复后严格比较该字段；本 blocker 正是比较结果不一致导致的。应改为「存储中可选；旧记录缺失时按写入它的操作推导后再参与校验」。

`docs/architecture/host-authority.md:18` 的 “keeps the field out of validation” 有同样歧义，建议与实现对齐。

## 七、需要确认的设计偏离

以下两项与已确认的 DESIGN 表述不完全一致，代码和文档已经自洽，但需要明确接受或修改：

1. **Human 不能 unfollow Main stream。** DESIGN 与票据 03 写的是「任何 Member 都能 follow/unfollow Main stream」，实现中 Human 的 Attention 由 Project 创建派生，unfollow 会被直接拒绝（`ledger.ts:1786` 附近）。理由成立（派生状态无法结束，不能记录空操作），但这是对原验收条件的收窄。
2. **离开 Workspace 与归档 Project 不收回 Main Attention。** `docs/team-collaboration/attention-and-messaging.md:55` 已明确写出这一不对称：Thread Attention 会被清理，Main Attention 保留，成员重新加入后会看到离开期间的消息。需要确认这是期望行为，而不是遗漏。

## 八、按 DESIGN 的验收测试缝对照

| # | 测试缝 | 结果 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 普通投递不受 owner 身份影响 | 达成 | `inbox-delivery.ts` 无 `owns`，无 threshold |
| 2 | Main stream 对称 follow/unfollow | 部分 | Agent 对称；Human 不能 unfollow |
| 3 | 默认 Attention 只建 Main，不批量订阅 Thread | 达成 | owner grant 仅在缺失时建行 |
| 4 | unfollow 后 @/reply/责任/reminder 仍到达 | 达成 | marker 路径独立 |
| 5 | active Claim 禁止 unfollow | 达成（Thread） | Main stream 无 Task，不适用 |
| 6 | 身份撤销不隐式删除 Attention | 达成 | `project-owner-removed` 保留行 |
| 7 | Host 投递仍有界、可去重 | 达成 | `signature` / `delivered` 分离，有测试 |
| 8 | Agent 指导与领域语义一致 | 部分 | source 已渲染；tool description 与 core skill 仍旧 |
| 9 | 持久化与重放覆盖迁移 | 未达成 | 合成用例通过；真实账本失败 |

## 九、验证记录

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `npx vitest run` | 122 files passed / 1 skipped；1,418 tests passed / 1 skipped；exit 0 |
| `npm run typecheck`（单独运行） | 通过，0 error |
| `npm run check:docs` | 通过：28 maintained documents、28 双语对、360 links |
| `npm run check:core-skills` | 通过：3 skills，`team-domain-model` 7,829/7,850 字符 |
| `node --import tsx scripts/check-team-trial-metrics.ts` | 通过，但 fixture 仍按旧投递模型，不能发现指标偏差 |
| 真实账本重放（`/tmp` 只读副本） | 失败：`invalid Thread read projection` |
| 真实账本在 `7558dfd` 上重放 | 通过 |
| 探针修复后重放当前构建 | 通过：25,525 条操作 |

补充：`npm run typecheck` 与全量测试并发运行时曾出现 `typert` 相关瞬时错误并仍返回 0；单独运行通过。复核结论以单独运行为准，但该并发行为本身值得在检查文档中说明。

## 十、未验证范围

- 未启动完整 Host 与 Web UI；重放失败已能证明构造阶段会拒绝该账本，但没有观察 `pnpm dsh --profile web-dev` 的实际界面表现。
- 未运行 `npm run test:browser`。本工作项改动了 Client 的 Main stream standing 字段（`owner` → `following`），试用前应补跑。
- 未用真实模型验证修改后的指导文案是否减少误用；这属于 `agent-tools-context-rendering` 的验证范围。
- 未修改仓库代码；所有探针均在 `/tmp` 中完成，工作树在复核前干净。

## 十一、建议处理顺序

1. 修 blocker：legacy 快照 source 比较 + read 操作 source 继承 + 真实形状回归用例。
2. 修模型可见文案：`team_thread`、`team_message`、`team-domain-model` core skill。
3. 修试用指标脚本并补两项 fixture。
4. 补票据 02.6、05.3 的测试与文案；修 `CHANGELOG` / `host-authority` 的 source 校验表述。
5. 明确 Human unfollow 与离开 Workspace 的语义，统一文档。
6. 全量测试、`test:browser`、真实账本重放。
7. dev profile 人工试用，完成后重新归档。

- Human 不能 unfollow Main stream、离开 Workspace 不收回 Main Attention 这两处设计偏离，需要确认是否接受。
